scope: Repair the reproduced production Frappe Desk boot failure that leaves authenticated administrators on the splash logo and blocks the first-run Setup Wizard.

Keep the approved React translation catalogs unchanged and remove only double-curly SPA placeholder messages from Frappe's server-rendered Desk boot dictionary through the supported extend_bootinfo hook.

Prove the filter with a focused regression, repository and direct i18n checks, exact-SHA ordinary CI, an encrypted pre-deploy backup, exact-SHA incremental deployment, authenticated Desk/Setup Wizard browser evidence and a final Level 3 release gate.
Preserve all existing Site data, named volumes, disabled ERP adapters, disabled ERP authorization ingress and the retained rollback image pair.
non_scope: No Frappe or ERPNext core patch, translation-key migration, user-visible copy change, architecture redesign, schema change, permission change or ERP activation.
No production ERPNext or JCE-Core contact, business-data mutation, generic DocType writer, cross-database access, browser-direct ERP access or dual-master field.
No deletion or recreation of the LaunchFlow Site, database or named volumes and no staging, rollback or overwrite of user-owned local files.
No password, token, cookie, endpoint configuration or other secret may be printed, committed or included in evidence.

expected_state.controller_marker: PA-09 production Frappe Desk boot hotfix active; exact-SHA ordinary CI required before deployment

rollback.before_product_resume: Discard only the PA-09 scoped files and restore the completed PA-08 controller state; production remains on the current image and needs no rollback.
rollback.after_product_resume: Take a fresh encrypted safety backup before switching images. If Desk verification fails, switch both backend and SPA to the retained PA-08 image pair without schema downgrade and run the production health gate; use a reviewed forward fix if image rollback is unsafe.
